description: Swap a forged copy of a painting you stole back onto the wall, so nobody notices it's gone. You must measure the real painting: its exact 8x8 grid of average colours (64 hex colours, row by row). Dr. Vera Provenance, the Authenticator, compares your copy with the original. Close enough = covered up (+1,000 GC); sloppy = jail and a strike. Call once without grid to get the image URL and exact rules. One try per painting.
name: forge_painting
